payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Assess the image as a whole. Complete: it convincingly reads as a chalk drawing, with the scene rendered as drawn forms and chalk-like marks throughout, rather than a photograph merely blurred or overlaid with chalk-like texture. Partial: clear visible movement toward a chalk drawing (such as chalk-like texture or sketchy forms), but the image still substantially reads as a photograph or the drawing transformation is incomplete. Absent: no visible progress toward a chalk drawing. Unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress or completion. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image has a chalky, grainy texture and softened, sketch-like forms, but the giraffes and scene still substantially read as a photograph rather than a fully rendered chalk drawing.","confidence":0.94}
